notes.title: Bugs update
notes.content: Dear players! The game launch bug has been fixed, we apologize for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update for "Pulse" – Meet new features and challenges!
notes.content:
[b]Character and Progress Saving[/b]


You can now save both your character and their current location in the game. Keep your progress safe and under control!


[b]Leveling and Skill Upgrade System[/b]


A new leveling system has been added to enhance your character’s skills every 5 levels with skill points. Here are the available skills you can upgrade:

[b]Health (HP)[/b] – Increases your character’s health points.

[b]Stamina[/b] – Boosts strength and endurance for longer fights.

[b]Damage[/b] – Increases the power of your attacks.

[b]Movement Speed[/b] – Speeds up your character's movement.

[b]Boost Exp[/b] – A special skill that multiplies experience points earned from enemies, accelerating your progress.


[b]New Enemies and Loot[/b]


Three new mobs have been added to the game, each with unique attacks and behaviors, adding new layers of challenge to battles. Enemies may now drop two new types of runes:

[b]Stamina Regeneration Rune[/b] – Restores stamina.

[b]Health Regeneration Rune[/b] – Restores HP.


[b]Quest NPC[/b]


The game now includes a quest-giving NPC who will guide you and explain the next steps. This character will be your helpful guide in navigating the game world.


[b]New Location – The Labyrinth[/b]


A new, challenging location has been added – the Labyrinth! It’s filled with the game’s most powerful monster hordes, promising intense gameplay. To access the Labyrinth, you’ll need to complete specific requirements given by the main dwarf NPC in his village. Find the village, complete quests, and unlock the path to the Labyrinth.


[b]Ready to take on all these new features? Face new quests, fierce battles, and unique rewards![/b]
